tagline: A 2023 First Class motor yacht with stabilisers, for 16 guests.
answer: Galapagos Angel is a 35-metre First Class motor yacht built in 2023, designed and built in the Netherlands, and sailed by Royal Galapagos. She carries 16 guests in 2 suites and 6 convertible cabins, with 10 crew and a bilingual naturalist guide, and has hydraulic stabilisers. Every route starts and ends at Baltra, from 4 to 8 days, from US$2,745 per person.

overview: Galapagos Angel is a 35-metre motor yacht built in 2023. Royal Galapagos says she was designed and built in the Netherlands and fitted with hydraulic stabilisers for a smooth ride. She is one of the company's two First Class yachts.

She takes 16 guests. Two 18-square-metre suites sit on the Upper Deck; six cabins of 13 to 14 square metres share the Main Deck with the dining room and lounge, and convert between double and twin. All have panoramic windows, private bathrooms, hot water and air conditioning. There is a bar, al fresco dining, a sundeck with a jacuzzi and onboard Wi-Fi.

All routes begin and end at Baltra. Week A covers North Seymour, Santiago, Genovesa, Rabida, the Santa Cruz highlands, Espanola, Santa Fe and South Plaza. Week B covers Bartolome, western Isabela, Fernandina, Sierra Negra and Floreana. Shorter 4, 5 and 7-day sections are cut from the same weeks.
why: A new yacht at a First Class price: built in 2023 with stabilisers, with 2027 rates from US$2,845 per person for 4 days.
Every departure starts and ends at Baltra, which makes flights simple and lets you join the A and B weeks into 15 days.

faqs: In 2023. Royal Galapagos says she was designed and built in the Netherlands.
How many guests does she carry?
Sixteen, in two suites and six convertible cabins, with ten crew and a bilingual naturalist guide.
Royal Galapagos says she has hydraulic stabilisers for a smooth ocean ride.
Where do Galapagos Angel cruises start?
Every route starts and ends at Baltra, on 4, 5, 7 or 8-day itineraries.
How much does a Galapagos Angel cruise cost?
Royal Galapagos' 2027 rack rates run from US$2,845 per person for 4 days in a standard cabin to US$7,645 for 8 days in a suite. Flights and park fees are extra.
Yes. A 2027 whole-yacht charter for 16 is US$38,450 for 4 days or US$99,450 for 8 days.
Week A: North Seymour, Santiago, Genovesa, Rabida, Santa Cruz, Espanola, Santa Fe and South Plaza. Week B: Bartolome, western Isabela, Fernandina, Sierra Negra and Floreana.
What does First Class mean here?
It is Royal Galapagos' own category, one step below its Luxury yachts. Angel and Calipso are its two First Class boats.
